n: Cough: when Cough is ticked, choose whether it is dry, with mucus or both, in the sickness form and in each day report

Temperature readings: while you are sick, add a reading any time from the Temperature tile on Home (or the thermometer on the sickness page). Each reading keeps its time. The day report takes the day’s highest reading, and the sickness page lists all readings per day

The cough type is shown with the symptom (for example “Cough (with mucus)”), in the CSV export and in backups. Day reports update the sickness: a cough that was dry on one day and with mucus on another becomes “both”
Home fits on one screen without scrolling: the main button on top, the other options as tiles in two columns

Day reports: for every day of a sickness, a short wizard asks about fever (highest temperature and when), how yesterday’s symptoms changed (gone, better, same, worse) and new ones, how you felt, energy and sleep, medication, work, bed rest, doctor and notes
Each sickness has its own page with the details, a fever chart and all day reports. Tap a sickness in History or Calendar to open it
Home shows “How was today?” while you are sick
Day reports update the sickness: new symptoms are added, “Off sick” days fill in Days off work, a doctor visit and medication are carried over
Day reports are included in backups and in the CSV export
Morning, afternoon or evening for the start and the end of a sickness
Sick days are now counted by thirds on the first and last day: Monday evening to Wednesday morning is 1.7 days. Sicknesses logged before count as full days, as they did
First version: log each sickness with first and last sick day, type, symptoms, severity, days off work, doctor visit, medication and notes
“I’m sick” starts an open sickness from today; “I’m well again” closes it
History with search and type filter, statistics per year, month, type and symptom, and a calendar with one year at a glance
Your own lists of sickness types and symptoms, colour themes, light and dark mode
Backup file to save and restore everything, CSV export for spreadsheets
Everything is stored on the phone only
